question: Justify the statement: Laws of reflection can be obtained as a special case of wavefront construction.

options.A: Reflection laws follow because secondary wavelets travel at different speeds in the same medium.
options.B: Huygens construction gives $i+r=90^\circ$ because secondary wavelets travel only along the normal.
options.C: In wavefront construction, points reached on the reflecting surface emit secondary wavelets. Since incident and reflected wavefronts move in the same medium with equal speed, the construction is symmetric about the normal, giving coplanarity of incident ray, reflected ray and normal, and $i=r$.
options.D: Huygens principle shows that the reflected ray is parallel to the incident ray for every angle.
